    Downloads

    downloads.Rmd

    Hub Setup Activity

    1. hub-setup-files.zip: compressed archive with the Hubverse time-series data, four previous forecast output files, the Quarto weekly report, and the GitHub Actions workflow configuration.

    Exercise 1 Data

    1. exercise-1-flu-hospitalizations.csv: historical influenza hospitalization data for five states used in Exercise 1.

    Exercise 2 Data

    1. exercise-2-2025-12-15.csv: target data for three groups used to explore recent reporting anomalies, data-drop choices, and model sensitivity in Exercise 2.
    2. exercise-2-2024-02-01.csv: target data for three groups used to compare forecast behavior at a different point in the outbreak season in Exercise 2.
